title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing
abstract: arXiv:2608.08514v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We independently reproduce two recent methods for making large language model (LLM) reasoning more reliable, and stress-test them across domains and models (RPC across four new task domains with Qwen3-8B, LCF across four 7-8B models). The first, RPC, aggregates token probabilities and self-consistency at inference; the second, LCF, trains projectors that split hidden states into "content" and "logic" and edits the logic part toward a valid region. Validating such reliability claims matters because the original evaluations are run by each method's own authors and were never independently reproduced or stress-tested across models and domains, and LCF shipped no public code. We re-run RPC's published-path aggregation and re-implement LCF's projector, contrastive, and intervention pipeline, then extend both to text-to-SQL, legal extraction, fallacy identification, and precedent grading, and probe LCF's representation directly. translated_title: 复现与压力测试两种大语言模型推理可靠性方法：测试时概率聚合与逻辑表示编辑
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.08514v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们独立复现了两种近期用于提高大语言模型（LLM）推理可靠性的方法，并在不同领域和模型上进行了压力测试（RPC方法在四个新任务领域上使用Qwen3-8B，LCF方法在四个7-8B模型上）。第一种方法RPC，在推理时聚合词元概率和自一致性；第二种方法LCF，训练投影器将隐藏状态分割为“内容”和“逻辑”两部分，并将逻辑部分编辑到有效区域。验证这些可靠性声明至关重要，因为原始评估由每种方法的作者自行进行，从未被独立复现或跨模型、跨领域压力测试，且LCF未发布公开代码。我们重新运行RPC的已发布路径聚合，重新实现LCF的投影器、对比和干预流程，然后将两者扩展到文本转SQL、法律提取、谬误识别和先例分级任务，并直接探测LCF的表示。RPC方法可复现。
tldr: 本研究独立复现并跨领域、跨模型压力测试了RPC和LCF两种LLM推理可靠性方法，发现RPC可复现，而LCF因未公开代码需重新实现，并扩展至四个新任务领域验证其泛化性。
en_tdlr: This study independently reproduces and stress-tests two LLM reasoning reliability methods (RPC and LCF) across domains and models, finding RPC reproducible while LCF required reimplementation due to no public code, and extends both to four new task domains.
